purpose: Reusable imagegen-created raster tarot border templates for Bird Squad Minor Arcana compositing.
rules: Templates are reusable border overlays, not finished cards.
Templates must be 1024x1536 RGBA PNG files.
The imageWindow region must be transparent so center art can show through.
The titleCartouche region must stay opaque and visually blank so compositor-owned title text has a stable plate.
Templates must not contain readable title text, suit words, rank text, logos, or pseudo-writing.
The compositor owns final title text.

Visual style must match the existing full-card Minor Arcana frame language: hand-inked black-and-aged-gold tarot ornament, colored enamel suit medallions, organic filigree, and weathered illustrated texture.
Reject templates that read as hard technology, sci-fi UI, machined industrial panels, circuit patterns, or antenna hardware.
